report.summary: Reviewed chunk 2 of drift.py (lines 281-). Claims enumerated and verdicts assigned.

handoff.purpose: Define drift kind constants, DocIndex, ignore_config, ScanResult, repo_state, and snapshot_freshness.

symbols.name: KIND_ORDER
symbols.note: Tuple ordering drift kinds for rendering.

symbols.name: NON_BLOCKING_KINDS
symbols.note: Frozenset of kinds that do not block.

symbols.name: ACCEPTABLE_KINDS
symbols.note: Frozenset of kinds that may be accepted.

symbols.name: DocIndex
symbols.note: Index of prose lines mentioning environment variables.

symbols.name: ScanResult
symbols.note: Holds scan state and derived data.

symbols.name: repo_state
symbols.note: Returns repository HEAD, branch, dirty state.

symbols.name: snapshot_freshness
symbols.note: Checks if snapshot describes current tree.

claims.text: Render order: the alarm that means 'somebody built something and never wired it' is first, the good news is last but always present
claims.why: KIND_ORDER tuple has INVALID_SNAPSHOT first and NOW_REACHED last.

claims.text: NOW_REACHED is good news. TEST_ONLY is a real finding that deliberately does not block
claims.why: NON_BLOCKING_KINDS includes both NOW_REACHED and TEST_ONLY.

claims.text: Acceptance hygiene, a broken snapshot and a changed ignore configuration are deliberately NOT acceptable
claims.why: ACCEPTABLE_KINDS does not include INVALID_SNAPSHOT, IGNORE_DRIFT, INVALID_ACCEPTANCE, STALE_ACCEPTANCE.

claims.text: Fenced blocks and generated files are dropped at BUILD time rather than at query time
claims.why: DocIndex.build skips files in GENERATED_DOCS and lines inside fenced blocks.

claims.text: there is exactly one place where 'does this text count' is decided
claims.why: DocIndex.build is the sole method deciding inclusion.

claims.text: Non-alphanumerics collapse to single spaces before counting
claims.why: _described uses _ALNUM_RUN.sub(' ', rest).strip() which collapses non-alphanumeric sequences.

claims.text: ``PKG_TURBO=1`` scores 1, not 12: punctuation and the value are not an explanation
claims.why: After replacing 'PKG_TURBO' with space, '=1' becomes ' 1'; _ALNUM_RUN.sub collapses spaces, length of trimmed string is 1.

claims.text: The env value is stored VERBATIM rather than hashed: the point is that a reviewer reading the failure can see what was hidden without re-running anything.
``sites`` is runtime-only detail (file:line) used to make remedies actionable, and is deliberately kept OUT of the snapshot so line-number churn never produces a diff a human has to read.
claims.why: ScanResult defines sites field separately from state; code does not store sites in snapshot.

claims.text: The digest proves nobody hand-edited the snapshot.
claims.why: Digest functionality is in _digest function defined elsewhere; this chunk does not contain it.

claims.text: There is deliberately NO ``generated_at``: a clock reading answers 'when did the generator run', which is the weaker question, and it would destroy the byte-identity this artifact is built on
claims.why: repo_state returns only head, branch, dirty; no generated_at field.

claims.text: ``dirty`` is probed only when there is a ``.git`` to probe, so a scan of a tree that is not a checkout costs no subprocess and still answers honestly: ``None`` means 'could not tell', never 'clean'.
claims.why: repo_state checks probe_dirty and head != 'unknown'; if head is 'unknown' it does not probe dirty, leaving it None.

claims.text: FAILS CLOSED on the artifact's own defects -- an absent, non-string or malformed ``repo_state.head`` means the snapshot cannot say what it scanned, and a snapshot that cannot say what it scanned is not evidence about this tree.
claims.why: snapshot_freshness checks isinstance(recorded, str) and .strip(); returns fresh=False with reason if not.

claims.text: FAILS OPEN when the recorded head is well-formed and git cannot answer at all: a tarball checkout with no ``.git`` is not evidence of staleness, and turning 'I cannot tell' into 'refuse everything' is a worse failure than ranking.
claims.why: The actual comparison with current HEAD is not in this chunk; the function is truncated.

observations.what: snapshot_freshness is incomplete; it only validates the recorded head but does not compare with actual_head in this chunk.
